sections.title: Checking every held field
sections.what: Loads saved data, builds the holds for each affected project, and checks the result against the input and the rules. Ends with a count check of 41.
sections.why: Tests the rule against real saved data, not invented examples.
sections.watch_out: The test confirms the input is not changed; code that edits the input will fail here.

summary: Checks that holding a value for review keeps the original data, rejects stale or unsupported input, and clears dependent figures for 41 held fields.
purpose: Verifies that holding a value does not destroy data or leave wrong numbers in place.
why: Likely reason: held figures must not come back through backup sources or old calculations.
how: Loads the committed snapshot and the research findings. For each project with findings, builds the hold, checks that the input is unchanged, checks the review record and that other attributes stay the same, clears the delay and cost backups, keeps unrelated narratives, and checks that stale input and empty rationale are rejected. Finally checks that 41 fields were held.
outputs: A PASS line, or an assertion failure.
risks: The count of 41 and the field names are fixed. Changing the data requires updating them.
debug: If the count fails, compare the findings file with the committed snapshot. If a stale check fails, look at the hold logic.
